integrity_notes: Finite-time numerical tests are diagnostics and do not establish the asymptotic claims.
The proof uses a differentiated, locally uniform Kummer asymptotic and identifies the strict derivative sign underlying uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The uniqueness and sign theorem is proved only on reset-rate interval [3 gamma/2,5 gamma/2] for sufficiently large observation times.
No explicit numerical lower horizon for validity, noisy-data stability, or experimental inference bounds are established.

The source exact Fourier transform determines all cumulants in principle; novelty is assessed for the uniform subleading critical-layer analysis and sharp unique threshold, not the preexisting transform.
An unindexed equivalent derivation remains a scientific priority risk.
title: A critical fourth-cumulant boundary layer in a preferentially resetting active particle
